identification: Two 1 imperial pint glass oil bottles with tin pourer tops. (1) Shell X-100 Motor Oil SAE 30 conical tin pourer top, cream with red print, red ribbed collar, no dust cap (spout open, oily black staining and wear near spout, otherwise print bright); plain-ish pint bottle with oily residue. (2) Castrol GTX tin pourer top (cream/green/black print heavily worn, with dust cap) on an embossed pint bottle (embossed text on shoulder not readable at 450px). Both have old oil residue.
